svg.title: Friuli study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Friuli; 2: Oslávia; 3: Cormons; 4: Rosazzo; 5: Cialla; 6: Buttrio; 7: Prepotto; 8: Trieste; 9: Treviso; 10: Udine

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
